title: generate-freeze-block: do not consider architecture variants
commit_message: generate-freeze-block: do not consider architecture variants
diff:
diff --git a/generate-freeze-block b/generate-freeze-block
index ea43ce6..4c71149 100755
--- a/generate-freeze-block
+++ b/generate-freeze-block
@@ -61,7 +61,8 @@ class GetPackage():
         ubuntu = lp.distributions['ubuntu']
         series = ubuntu.current_series.name
         self.all_arches = [a.architecture_tag
-                          for a in ubuntu.current_series.architectures]
+                           for a in ubuntu.current_series.architectures
+                           if a.underlying_architecture_tag is None]
         main_arches = ("amd64", "i386")
         port_arches = set(self.all_arches) - set(main_arches)
